pages.text: Rename a villager with a name tag to "Messi" ("Lionel Messi", "Lionel Andres Messi", "Leo Messi" and "La Pulga" also work, in any case and with or without accents).$(br2)The villager becomes a tribute: fireworks, cheering sounds and a world champion message.
From then on that villager sells you The Cup for 32 emeralds (once per villager).$(br2)The Cup can also be crafted from gold, but this way it has its story.
